text:
Type: geometric runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, kitchen, entryway, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a textured line pattern
Colors: light grey, taupe, off-white
Shape: long narrow rectangle, repeating triangles of nested lines forming a geometric grid, tone-on-tone texture, flat low pile, light visual weight
Feel: clean, airy, calm
Goes with: dark wood floors, white or grey cabinets, silver hardware; modern or minimalist rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Runner Rug, 2' 10" x 7' 10", Grey and Taupe
product.description: Upgrade your hallway or other narrow floor space with this beautiful rug. With a classic geometric pattern updated to suit modern tastes, this rug is a perfect addition to transitional-style home décor, and its taupe and gray tones will blend well with most color themes. 2'10"W x 7'10"L Imported. 49% polyester, 29% polypropylene, 16% jute, 6% cotton Machine made with a textured geometric pattern Medium .39" pile suits any indoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
